a.text: The population of Loveland was 12,081 at the 2010 census.

b.text: As of the census of 2010, there were 12,081 people, 4,701 households, and 3,270 families residing in the city.

a.text: The population of Loveland was estimated at 13,145 in 2019.
The Ohio Flood of March 1913 destroyed a corn mill in Loveland.

b.text: The Ohio Flood of March 1913 washed out the Loveland Bridge.

a.text: In 1996 Loveland moved its eastern border by purchasing Col. Paxtons original White Pillars homestead.

b.text: The city acquired the White Pillars property.
